    1. executeOnServer(GameController)

Interface ClientRequest

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AddPlayerRequest, CardPickRequest, CreateGameRequest, GameSyncRequest, LobbyStateRequest, PingRequest, ReconnectRequest, SkipExtraPickRequest, TotemMoveRequest
public interface ClientRequest extends Serializable
A command sent from a client to the server. Each concrete request is a Serializable record carrying the data of one client action; it is shipped over the network (RMI or socket) and, once received, applies itself to the GameController via executeOnServer(GameController).

This follows the Command pattern: the server does not switch on a request type, it simply calls executeOnServer(GameController) and lets each request route itself to the right controller method.

    executeOnServer(GameController controller)
